title: Grimoire Bound in Imp Skin
summary: Read Helsik’s ritual book to learn how to open the portal to the House of Hope.

fields.Ritual: In the Devil’s Fee upstairs circle, put the skull on the western point nearest the altar. Place Coin of Mammon northwest beside the skull, diamond on the northeastern point, incense on the southeastern point, and Infernal Marble in the centre.
fields.Acquisition: Helsik supplies the grimoire at the Devil’s Fee.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
